Nexus v1.1.0 上传字段（直接复制粘贴）
=====================================================

【NAME】
Silver Pines Combat


【SHORT DESCRIPTION】（列表页一行，限 ~200 字符）

首选：
Silver Pines combat overhaul: dodge-cancel any attack, stomp that actually closes the gap, aim unaffected by movement, expandable inventory. Runtime patch, nothing on disk touched.

备选 A：
Combat overhaul + QoL for Silver Pines: dodge cancels any attack, stomp closes the gap, movement no longer drags your aim, expandable inventory. Runtime patch - no game file modified.

备选 B：
Fixes Silver Pines combat feel: attacks are dodge-cancellable at any point, stomp snaps into range, movement stops dragging your aim, inventory can grow. No game files modified.


【FILES 栏描述】

SilverPinesCombat-1.1.0-full.zip  （Main file / 34.4 MB）
Main file. Plugin + BepInEx 6.0.0-be.789 runtime in one archive - nothing else needed.
Extract into the game root (same folder as Carpenter.exe). Watch out: Windows "Extract All" pre-fills a subfolder name; delete it or winhttp.dll ends up one level too deep and the mod silently never loads.
First launch takes 1-3 minutes while BepInEx generates interop assemblies. That is normal.

SilverPinesCombat-1.1.0.zip  （Optional file / 57 KB）
Plugin only. Use this if you already run BepInEx 6 IL2CPP be.789 or newer - merge its BepInEx folder into the game root and your existing setup stays as it is.
Not compatible with the be.788 pack hosted on this site (one build behind what this was built and tested against).


【CHANGELOG / 版本说明】（可选，填在 Files 的 changelog 或 Description 顶部）

1.1.0
- New: expandable inventory (0-10 extra rows, panel slider). Shrinking is refused while the extra rows still hold items.
- New: movement input no longer changes your aim angle (left stick / WASD). Right stick or mouse still turns you.
- New: visible dodge i-frames (off by default) - character tints bright cyan while invulnerable.
- Removed: the unfinished aim-assist implementation and its debug probe.

1.0.0
- Dodge cancels attacks at any point.
- Stomp steps forward into range instead of whiffing.
- Thin aim line from the muzzle.

Gameplay + Utilities for Players
